# Know Your Meme & TV Guide

> > A combined resource for internet culture documentation and television programming, covering viral memes, TikTok trends, streaming content, and TV schedules.

This site aggregates content from Know Your Meme (documenting viral internet phenomena, memes, and social media trends) and TV Guide (providing TV listings, streaming recommendations, and entertainment news). It serves as a reference for both digital culture and traditional media consumption.

## Key Topics

- Know Your Meme
- TikTok trends
- TV Guide
- Netflix streaming
- Viral memes
- Internet slang
- TV schedules
- Entertainment news
- Exploitable memes
- Image macros
- Catchphrases
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Live sports schedules
- Local TV listings
- Meme culture documentation

## Core Resources

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations, TV reviews, and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule and channel listings by provider
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule across MLB, NBA, NHL, NCAA, UEFA, etc.
- [What to Watch on Netflix - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/streaming/netflix): Netflix catalog browser with filters for movies, TV shows, and genres

## Popular Memes & Internet Culture

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White and Jesse Pinkman
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl lying over cat/kitten burial
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): Meme about cliche millennial burger restaurant aesthetic and branding
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok
